summary: Three gates were blind to the first component of its kind, found by probing before Presence shipped. check:utilities did not know Tailwind's starting: variant (CSS @starting-style), so `starting:bg-zzz` passed while compiling to nothing; `starting` is now in the shared VARIANT list, and the enter/exit transform rule reads it too. check:motion's travel rule matched only data-[starting-style], so `starting:translate-y-1` — a literal slide that Reduced cannot take away — passed; it now matches both spellings. check:contrast required every component to declare contrast pairs, and Presence paints nothing; a component may now declare a11y.rendersNoColour with a sentence of reason instead, which the gate rejects if it is short or sits beside pairs. Each rule was probed failing first.
